def anchors_of(name):
    gi=G[name+' input']
    bg=Counter(x for r in gi for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cs=components(gi,bg); cs.sort(key=len,reverse=True)
    tmpl=cs[0]; r0=min(x for x,_ in tmpl); c0=min(y for _,y in tmpl)
    good=[(r-r0,c-c0) for (r,c) in sorted(tmpl) if f_anchor(gi,(r-r0,c-c0),bg)==G[name+' output']]
    singles=[p for comp in cs[1:] for p in comp]
    return (r0,c0,tmpl,good,singles,gi)

for name in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4']:
    r0,c0,tmpl,good,singles,gi=anchors_of(name)
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    sc=(sum(p[0] for p in singles)/len(singles), sum(p[1] for p in singles)/len(singles))
    r1,r2=good[0],good[-1]
    def dist(c, pt): return abs(c[0]+r0-pt[0])+abs(c[1]+c0-pt[1])

def pick_anchor(tmpl, gi, r0, c0):
    tset=set(tmpl)
    R=max(x for x,_ in tmpl)-r0+1; C=max(y for _,y in tmpl)-c0+1
    cent=(sum(x for x,_ in tmpl)/len(tmpl), sum(y for _,y in tmpl)/len(tmpl))
    cnt=Counter(gi[x][y] for x,y in tmpl)
    def deg(c):
        x,y=c; return sum((x+dx,y+dy) in tset for dx,dy in [(1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)])
    return min(sorted(tmpl), key=lambda c: (-deg(c), -cnt[gi[c[0]][c[1]]],
              abs(c[0]-cent[0])+abs(c[1]-cent[1])))

                                seen.add((a,b)); q.append((a,b))
                comps.append(comp)

res_all=[]
for k in range(1,9):
    gi_=GG[f'Demo pair {k} input']; go_=GG[f'Demo pair {k} output']
    bg=Counter(x for r_ in gi_ for x in r_).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cs=comps_fn(gi_,bg)
    tmpl=cs[0]; singles=[c[0] for c in cs[1:]]
    tr=min(r_ for r_,c_ in tmpl); tc=min(c_ for r_,c_ in tmpl)
    hT=max(r_ for r_,c_ in tmpl)-tr+1; wT=max(c_ for r_,c_ in tmpl)-tc+1
    trel={(r_-tr,c_-tc):gi_[r_][c_] for r_,c_ in tmpl}
    # find each single's copy offset from output: try all anchors, or better: match cells
    out_cells={(r_,c_):go_[r_][c_] for r_ in range(len(go_)) for c_ in range(len(go_[0])) if go_[r_][c_]!=bg}
    info=[]
    for (pr,pc) in singles:
        # candidate shifts: anchor cell a: shift=(pr-tr-a[0], pc-tc-a[1])... copy cells = tmpl + shift; must cover pixel
        cands=[]
        for a in trel:
            dr=pr-tr-a[0]; dc=pc-tc-a[1]
            cells=[(r_+dr,c_+dc) for r_,c_ in trel]
            if all(0<=r_<len(go_) and 0<=c_<len(go_[0]) for r_,c_ in cells):
                if all(out_cells.get((r_,c_))==trel[(r_-dr,c_-dc)] for r_,c_ in cells):
                    # also ensure these output cells aren't shared ambiguously? just record
                    cands.append(a)
        info.append(((pr,pc),cands))
    res_all.append(dict(k=k,bg=bg,shape=(hT,wT),tr=tr,tc=tc,trel=trel,singles=singles,info=info))
    print(f'D{k} bg={bg} shape={(hT,wT)} tmpl@({tr},{tc}) nsing={len(singles)}')
    for (pr,pc),cands in info:
        print('   single',(pr,pc),'feasible anchors:',cands)

def transform(grid):
    bg=Counter(x for row in grid for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cs=comps_fn(grid,bg)
    tmpl=cs[0]; singles=[c[0] for c in cs[1:]]
    tr=min(r for r,c in tmpl); tc=min(c for r,c in tmpl)
    hT=max(r for r,c in tmpl)-tr+1; wT=max(c for r,c in tmpl)-tc+1
    trel={(r-tr,c-tc):grid[r][c] for r,c in tmpl}
    ar,ac=(hT-1)//2,(wT-1)//2
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for (pr,pc) in singles:
        for (r,c),v in trel.items():
            out[pr-ar+r][pc-ac+c]=v
    return out
